invariants.rationale: The method requires a HoodieWriteConfig to function; null config is likely invalid.
The method requires a HoodieEngineContext to function; null context is likely invalid.
getBasePath() is used to initialize the HoodieTableMetaClient and is required.
getStorageConf() is called immediately; it must not be null.
The consistency guard config is passed to the meta client builder and must not be null.
